scope: Seller supplies fully connected sensor/PCB module. Buyer installs unchanged retail battery only.

sequence.operation: Print separator/lower/upper and remove support; gauge two axial holes with intended wire stock.
sequence.gate: Actual hole clearance and support removal without rail damage untested.

sequence.operation: Prepare sensor-to-wire joints and insulation in an external fixture, leaving PCB ends unsoldered.
sequence.gate: Joint insulation, minimum retention collar dimensions, solder heat process and pull-test acceptance remain undefined.

sequence.operation: Feed free PCB wire ends through axial-stop holes from the sensor side. Bring sensor into position from below separator while feeding wire slack.
sequence.gate: Sensor/joint straight upward envelopes clear; flexible wire threading path and handling access unvalidated.

sequence.operation: Route wires to PCB pads and solder using the screened tool approach before fitting battery or enclosure.
sequence.gate: Actual tool envelope, flux/heat, cleaning, separation from PLA and joint inspection unvalidated.

sequence.operation: Inspect polarity, sensor resistance, insulation and retention; flash and electrically test completed module.
sequence.gate: This is a seller operation; no buyer soldering, wire modification or connector exchange.

sequence.operation: Fit tested module to enclosure; provide buyer battery installation and final closure instructions.
sequence.gate: Original battery harness routing/mating plug, module insertion, closure adhesive and charge/runtime tests remain open.

rejected_simple_paths: Sensor translated from above separator collides with integral bridges.
Sensor translated from its tip along its axis collides with separator.
decision: Keep bottom insertion as candidate; do not claim preassembly is feasible until threading and sensor-joint insulation are modeled or bench verified.
